assets.name: guest-portraits.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square character portrait atlas for Castle Chaos, a humorous medieval 3D castle-siege browser game for adults.
Primary request: one square raster image arranged as an exact 2x2 grid of four separate cinematic stylized 3D bust portraits. Each quadrant is exactly identical in size and the portraits touch at the central seams; no gaps, no border, no framing, no text.
Subjects and placement: TOP LEFT: eccentric elderly medieval scientist with silver wild hair, round bronze goggles, a green glass vial visible beside his bust, and a slightly deranged smile. TOP RIGHT: no-nonsense stout middle-aged female castle mason with a leather cap, freckles, and a hammer over her shoulder. BOTTOM LEFT: wily middle-aged male goat wrangler with a fur collar and one goat head beside him. BOTTOM RIGHT: handsome smug dark-haired male troubadour with a purple floppy hat, a feather, and a lute partly visible.
Style/medium: original grown-up comic fantasy, expressive believable faces, tactile detailed 3D with premium stop-motion craftsmanship, textured skin, felt and leather. Comedic attitude with refined cinematic finish.
Composition: all four busts at matching scale with entire faces and distinctive hats fully visible, each portrait independently centered within its quadrant; shoulders and held props may crop at quadrant edges. Equal 512-by-512 style cells in a square 1024-by-1024 atlas.
Lighting/background: warm amber rim light; the same plain dark evergreen background behind every subject.
Avoid: extra people, lettering, labels, UI, borders, panels, dividers, logos, watermarks, photorealism, flat 2D illustration, child's cartoon style.

assets.name: castle-stone.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless tileable square PBR base-color/albedo texture for the walls of a stylized medieval castle in an original 3D browser game.
Primary request: an evenly detailed wall of irregular chunky hand-cut medieval limestone blocks. The overall color is grey with warm desaturated olive tones. Add natural cracks and restrained, understated moss in some mortar crevices. Refined stylized 3D game material, with subtle readable color variation across the blocks.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat front-on texture, orthographic, all four edges tile seamlessly. Blocks run all the way to every edge. A modest number of medium-sized chunky blocks, no recognizable focal object.
Lighting: base color only, uniform neutral illumination, no cast shadows, no directional shading, no vignette, no baked ambient occlusion.
Constraints: square 1024-by-1024 raster texture. No perspective, no bevel render, no architecture silhouette, no sky, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark.
